what: Harvestability of the June-2022 stress-regime positive: is the +0.049bp passive maker P&L extractable by an inventory-aware quote or a cross-root flow signal? Both corollary nulls re-run on the stress regime.

quoting_null_jun2022.reading: PBO ~0.5 (coin-flip) = IS-best quoting config has no OOS edge; skew adds nothing over symmetric. Same verdict as calm (PBO 0.543).

ofi_null_jun2022.reading: cross-root flow adds nothing OOS (incrR2<0) and dies after taker cost; 0/13 roots significant. Same verdict as calm.

synthesis: The stress-regime maker positive is a passive liquidity-provision premium for bearing risk in a vol spike, NOT an alpha a quote or flow signal can extract. The two corollary nulls (quoting, cross-root OFI) hold in BOTH regimes; only the raw passive decomposition shifts (net ~0 calm -> +0.049 stress).
